title: Read the Desk at a glance
done: That is it: each row of the Desk opens to show what lies behind it.

steps.caption: Plan is the agent's own task list. The step in progress is lit.
Now lists what the agent did last, newest first, with how long ago.
Waiting shows work left running in the background, and wake-ups the agent set.
Last word is the agent's closing message, or says that it is still at work.
For you holds the files the agent sent you.
Your turn: click a row in Now to see what lies behind it.
